jobs.title: Product Engineer - Frontend focus (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Who We Are  Manufacturing runs on fragmented data: machines, sensors and decade-old systems that don't talk to each other. Data sits in departmental silos, knowledge lives in people's heads, and AI can't unfold its potential in point solutions that don't deliver. At Manex AI, we build the missing layer. Our platform handles manufacturing data at scale, models the factory ontology and builds agentic applications that reason and act across it.  We're a fast-growing team in Munich, backed by Lightspeed and BlueYard, with engineers from top companies and leading enterprise manufacturers as customers. We ship fast, work close to the shopfloor, and we don't ship things we're not proud of.    The Role  As Product Engineer with a frontend focus, you'll build the product features our customers use every day, fully owning the product with a strong focus on usability and intuitive design. You'll use AI to ship a high volume of polished work and stay close to the problems of the people who use it.
